items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Now Benny Goodman, I did play with Benny. I did one gig with Benny and I knew him off and on for the rest of his life.

ctx.x: Well I didn’t play per se behind Frank. We did work with Frank Sinatra on a number of occasions. Frank had his own drummer, Irv Cottler, the great Irv Cottler, and I was able to hang out with Irv a little bit, and actually met Sinatra. We had a little chat one night

backstage which was just delightful. So I was in the area. I could see what was happening. And that was great. It was scary enough being around their — on Broadway, it was Count Basie, Frank Sinatra, and Ella Fitzgerald. And then we went out on a little tour in a couple of cities, same group. Then we went over to the Palladium and we did a couple of weeks at the Palladium in London with Frank Sinatra, Sarah Vaughan and Count Basie. And then we did one which actually had me scared all up and down, we did a Royal…
